name: MaishaPay Gateway
author: jacquesmvumbi08

sections.description:
MaishaPay Gateway for WooCommerce enables merchants to securely accept online payments directly from their WooCommerce store using Mobile Money and bank cards across Africa.

Designed for businesses of all sizes, the plugin provides a fast, secure, and seamless payment experience while keeping WooCommerce orders automatically synchronized with MaishaPay.

Accept Payments With

  • M-Pesa
  • Airtel Money
  • Orange Money
  • MoMo
  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express

Customers are securely redirected to the official MaishaPay Checkout to complete their payment.

Features

  • Modern and intuitive administration dashboard
  • Real-time transaction monitoring
  • Detailed transaction history
  • Reports and payment statistics
  • Automatic payment confirmation
  • WooCommerce order synchronization
  • HPOS (High Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Automatic Checkout compatibility
  • Sandbox and Live environments
  • Multi-currency support (USD, CDF, CFA, EUR)
  • Secure API integration
  • Optimized performance

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • A valid MaishaPay merchant account

Getting Started

  1. Create a merchant account on MaishaPay.
  2. Retrieve your Public API Key and Secret API Key.
  3. Configure the plugin.
  4. Select Sandbox or Live mode.
  5. Start accepting payments immediately.

Why Choose MaishaPay?

MaishaPay offers businesses a reliable payment solution supporting both Mobile Money and international card payments through a single integration.

Whether you operate a local business or an international e-commerce store, MaishaPay helps you collect payments quickly, securely, and efficiently.

Supported Payment Methods

  • M-Pesa
  • Airtel Money
  • Orange Money
  • MoMo
  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express

Supported Currencies

  • USD
  • CDF
  • CFA
  • EUR

Support

Website:
https://www.maishapay.online

Support:
support@maishapay.online

Developed and maintained by the MaishaPay Team.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin.
  4. Select the MaishaPay Gateway ZIP file.
  5. Install and activate the plugin.
  6. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  7. Enable MaishaPay Gateway.
  8. Enter your Public API Key and Secret API Key.
  9. Select Sandbox or Live mode.
  10. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Is Sandbox mode available?

Yes. You can safely test your integration using Sandbox mode before switching to Live mode.

Which currencies are supported?

The plugin supports USD, CDF, CFA and EUR.

Is HPOS supported?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I accept card payments?

Yes. Visa, Mastercard and American Express are supported.
